## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?  
CAUTION. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive; confirmers: weak sector breadth (4/11) and narrow leadership concentrated in Technology (Top 5 all Tech), signalling mixed internals and elevated risk of rotation.

2. Which sectors are leading?  
Technology leads: NOW (1W: +33.03% | 1M: +53.84%) ABOVE TREND, ORCL (1W: +29.19% | 1M: +53.76%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +10.02% | 1M: +13.18%) ABOVE TREND. Industrials showing selective strength: BA (1W: +2.41% | 1M: -2.07%) RECOVERY. Consumer Discretionary modestly positive: F (1W: +11.39% | 1M: +39.40%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?  
Utilities weak: CEG (1W: -9.65% | 1M: -14.98%) BELOW TREND. Consumer Staples weak: MO (1W: -7.10% | 1M: -5.51%) BELOW TREND. Real Estate weak: WELL (1W: -8.70% | 1M: -8.88%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?  
Top 5: NOW (1W: +33.03% | 1M: +53.84%) ABOVE TREND, ORCL (1W: +29.19% | 1M: +53.76%) ABOVE TREND, IBM (1W: +26.23% | 1M: +39.74%) ABOVE TREND, SHOP (1W: +20.50% | 1M: +2.47%) ABOVE TREND, PLTR (1W: +17.37% | 1M: +15.48%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (5/5 Technology) — a concentration risk.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?  
Bottom 5: MO (1W: -7.10% | 1M: -5.51%) BELOW TREND, VTR (1W: -7.34% | 1M: -7.00%) BELOW TREND, BMY (1W: -7.58% | 1M: -9.31%) BELOW TREND, COST (1W: -7.99% | 1M: -6.61%) BELOW TREND, PM (1W: -8.64% | 1M: +4.60%) CORRECTION.

6. Momentum Stocks?  
Highest 1W movers: NOW (1W: +33.03% | 1M: +53.84%) ABOVE TREND, ORCL (1W: +29.19% | 1M: +53.76%) ABOVE TREND, IBM (1W: +26.23% | 1M: +39.74%) ABOVE TREND, SHOP (1W: +20.50% | 1M: +2.47%) ABOVE TREND, PANW (1W: +15.31% | 1M: +67.57%) ABOVE TREND. Major divergence present: AAPL (1W: -0.81% | 1M: +12.99%) CORRECTION, INTC (1W: -8.77% | 1M: +15.72%) CORRECTION, TSLA (1W: -2.38% | 1M: +8.97%) CORRECTION — tactical setups, not broad confirmation.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?  
Tech is strong on a handful of names but leadership is concentrated; NVDA (1W: +4.19% | 1M: +12.42%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +10.02% | 1M: +13.18%) ABOVE TREND, ADBE (1W: +11.96% | 1M: +11.35%) ABOVE TREND — sector is outperforming but narrow.

8. Financials Outlook?  
Financials are lagging: JPM (1W: -3.20% | 1M: -5.32%) BELOW TREND, CME (1W: -11.49% | 1M: -10.44%) BELOW TREND, V (1W: -1.86% | 1M: -1.94%) BELOW TREND — breadth negative and adds to CAUTION.

9. Healthcare Outlook?  
Healthcare mixed: LLY (1W: +1.62% | 1M: +15.99%) ABOVE TREND with strong news flow, UNH (1W: -2.22% | 1M: +2.53%) CORRECTION, JNJ (1W: -4.07% | 1M: -2.20%) BELOW TREND — sentiment-driven winners coexist with defensive softness.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?  
Favor selective Technology winners and high-conviction healthcare names (LLY, PANW, NOW); reduce exposure to the weakest defensive pockets (Utilities, Staples) and lagging Financials until breadth improves. Style: mixed / no clear leadership given narrow Tech top and weak sector breadth.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?  
BULLISH: PANW (1W: +15.31% | 1M: +67.57%) ABOVE TREND — news confirmed by price; LLY (1W: +1.62% | 1M: +15.99%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment-confirmed; NOW (1W: +33.03% | 1M: +53.84%) ABOVE TREND — momentum continuation candidate.  
BEARISH: INTC (1W: -8.77% | 1M: +15.72%) CORRECTION — watch for further distribution; CME (1W: -11.49% | 1M: -10.44%) BELOW TREND — operational risk; WMB (1W: -10.74% | 1M: -8.22%) BELOW TREND — sector pressure.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?  
BULLISH: Technology (1W: +8.88% | 1M: +20.24%) — but narrow leadership; Industrials (1W: +2.07% | 1M: +0.60%) showing selective gains.  
BEARISH: Utilities (1W: -5.12% | 1M: -7.22%), Consumer Staples (1W: -3.53% | 1M: -0.67%) — defensive weakness continues.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?  
NVDA 1W/1M strength to hold above near-term pivot (~900 area) would reinforce ABOVE TREND continuation; MSFT (1W: +10.02% | 1M: +13.18%) support ~current weekly lows to validate trend; AAPL (1W: -0.81% | 1M: +12.99%) hold above prior support to avoid deeper CORRECTION; CME breach of recent lows (1W: -11.49% | 1M: -10.44%) would signal extended downside.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?  
LLY (+65): LLY (1W: +1.62% | 1M: +15.99%) ABOVE TREND — Phase 3 news confirmed by price.  
PANW (+60): PANW (1W: +15.31% | 1M: +67.57%) ABOVE TREND — NATO partnership news confirming rally.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?  
TSLA (-45): TSLA (1W: -2.38% | 1M: +8.97%) CORRECTION — negative robotics headlines while price shows short-term distribution.  
UNH (-45): UNH (1W: -2.22% | 1M: +2.53%) CORRECTION — legal risk aligning with recent pullback.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION, style mixed / no clear leadership as narrow Tech winners contrast with weak breadth. NOW, ORCL and MSFT showing strength (ABOVE TREND) while Utilities and Staples show weakness (CEG, MO BELOW TREND). Key risk is concentrated leadership and major 1W/1M divergences (AAPL, INTC, TSLA) that warrant caution and monitoring of sentiment-driven names.
